Vente Pain Relief Clinic is Toronto's premier deep tissue Massage Therapy and Acupuncture clinic. These are some helpful videos to potentially help in alleviating and preventing pain. Please realize that proper treatment of ailments/conditions/symptoms require an appointment for assessment and treatment. These videos are meant for educational purposes ONLY and not meant as a form of treatment, assessment and diagnosis. Always consult with your health care practitioner for advice in regards to proper treatment. WE ARE NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR ANY POTENTIAL INJURIES THAT MAY RESULT FROM FOLLOWING THE VIDEOS. 
To book an appointment,  we can be reached at 416-644-8894. You can also email us at admin@ventepainrelief.com
